Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready transparent visual novel character sprite, canonical base pose
Input images: Image 1 is the approved canonical identity and design sheet for Lin Xia. It is the only identity source.
Primary request: create a clean standard visual novel sprite of the exact same Lin Xia from Image 1, adult age 22, shown from mid-thigh upward in a relaxed neutral standing pose. Both hands visible: one hand naturally resting near the side seam of her long skirt, the other lightly touching the cuff of her rolled overshirt. Calm attentive expression suitable as the default dialogue pose.
Identity invariants: preserve exactly her oval facial geometry and subtle pointed chin, warm amber-brown eye shape and color, long straight blue-black hair and exact airy bang grouping, thin gold star hairpin on the same side, natural slim adult proportions, indigo utility overshirt with rolled sleeves, cream crew-neck top, high-waisted navy skirt, analog wristwatch. Do not redesign or simplify signature details.
Style/medium: match Image 1 exactly—clean contemporary Japanese anime production artwork, thin confident ink lines, mostly flat cel colors, one hard-edged shadow tone, minimal highlights, matte skin, subtle hand-drawn 2D texture.
Composition/framing: single character only, centered, mid-thigh-up crop, complete hair silhouette and both hands inside canvas, straight-on three-quarter view, generous transparent padding around silhouette.
Background: genuinely transparent background with clean alpha edges; no glow, halo, floor shadow, gradient or scenery.
Constraints: clearly adult age 22; non-sexualized; neutral usable base pose; no text; no watermark.
Avoid: identity drift, different face, altered bangs or hair length, missing star hairpin, clothing redesign, glossy skin, oily highlights, airbrushed gradients, painterly rendering, 3D look, photorealism, Western comic anatomy, voluptuous exaggeration, pin-up pose, bloom, lens flare.
